definition: Unable to produce the intended result or sufficient effect.
author: William Shakespeare
quote: The glow-worm shows the matin to be near, And 'gins to pale his ineffectual fire: Adieu, adieu, adieu!
example_sentence: The fan was ineffectual against the summer heat.
